newsitem.title: USA: December Texas power rises in tandem with natgas.
newsitem.headline: December Texas power rises in tandem with natgas.

text.p: Short-term wholesale power prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) moved higher Wednesday with December power surging in line with increases in natural gas prices, sources said.
San Juan natural gas prices rose significantly Wednesday, pushing ERCOT December peak power discussion to the $29.50-31.25 range from $25.25-25.75 on Tuesday, brokers and marketers said.
January/February ERCOT power prices were pegged in the $30.00-31.00 range from $25.30-25.85 on Tuesday, the sources said.
Short-term ERCOT power prices were slightly higher, with peak, firm power for Thursday delivery quoted in the $26.00-27.00 range from $24.00-26.00 on Tuesday, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak non-firm ERCOT power transactions were notionally pegged higher at $11.00-13.00 from $10.00-12.00.
